name: browser-use
headline: claude skills playground for ai automation
short_description: A collection of seven custom skills extending Claude's capabilities with specialized workflows for meal planning, brainstorming, resume building, performance reviews, presentations, task conversion, and structured problem-solving.
author: toddward

sections.overview:
Claude Skills Playground is a curated collection of seven custom skills designed to extend Claude's capabilities with specialized workflows and tools. Each skill addresses specific use cases: Family Menu Generator creates protein-focused weekly dinner menus with PDF output; Brainstorm-it refines rough ideas through structured Socratic questioning; Resume Builder generates professionally formatted PDF resumes; Quarterly Connection Assistant guides performance reflections aligned with company values; Template Slide Deck creates branded presentations; AutoClaude Task Converter migrates markdown task backlogs to structured specs; and Thinking Frameworks applies multi-perspective analysis to decision-making. These skills work autonomously within Claude Code by providing instructions, scripts, and assets that enable complex multi-step operations without manual intervention.
Creating protein-focused weekly family dinner menus with PDF output
Refining product ideas and designs through structured brainstorming
Generating job-tailored professional resumes and cover letters
Preparing quarterly performance reviews aligned with company values
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/toddward/claude-skills-playground`
sections.usage:
```
I want to automate a workflow using the claude-skills-playground. Here's what I need: [DESCRIBE WORKFLOW]. Can you help me design an automation sequence using this skill?
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
